<!-- Included by report.qmd. Shares its params. Barrier-mesh comparison (land as a barrier). -->

```{r barrier-section, eval=params$include_barrier}
#| output: asis
cat("## Barrier mesh\n\n")
fit_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
land    <- ggOceanMaps::basemap_data(data = dt, crs = dt_crs)$shapefiles$land
mesh_b  <- sdmTMBextra::add_barrier_mesh(mesh, land, proj_scaling = 1000)
plot_mesh(mesh_b, crs = dt_crs, data = dt)
fit_b   <- update(fit_total, mesh = mesh_b)
cmp     <- compare_models(fit_total, fit_b, newdata = grid, reference_model = 1)
print(plot(cmp, type = "index"))
```
